Welcome to the Finology Academy of Mutual Funds!
In this fifth episode, we move into the safer, fixed-income side of investing, decoding Debt Mutual Funds so you know how they generate steady returns, where they beat traditional Fixed Deposits, and what hidden risks to watch out for.
Key concepts explained in this episode:
• How do debt mutual funds actually make money from interest payments (yield) and bond price changes?
• What are the two biggest hidden risks in debt funds and how do they affect your returns?
